en.text: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

zhSimplified.text: 我所赞美的 神啊， 求你不要闭口不言。

zhTraditional.text: 我所讚美的上帝啊， 求你不要閉口不言。

en.text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我； 他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。

zhTraditional.text: 因為惡人的嘴和詭詐人的口已經張開攻擊我； 他們用撒謊的舌頭對我說話。

en.text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

zhSimplified.text: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话， 又无故地攻打我。

zhTraditional.text: 他們圍繞我，說怨恨的話， 又無故地攻打我。

en.text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

zhSimplified.text: 他们与我为敌以报我爱， 但我专心祈祷。

zhTraditional.text: 他們與我為敵以報我愛， 但我專心祈禱。

en.text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

zhSimplified.text: 他们向我以恶报善， 以恨报爱。

zhTraditional.text: 他們向我以惡報善， 以恨報愛。

en.text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他， 派一个对头站在他右边！

zhTraditional.text: 願你派一個惡人轄制他， 派一個對頭站在他右邊！

en.text: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

zhSimplified.text: 他受审判的时候， 愿他出来担当罪名！ 愿他的祈祷反成为罪！

zhTraditional.text: 他受審判的時候， 願他出來擔當罪名！ 願他的祈禱反成為罪！

en.text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的年日短少！ 愿别人得他的职分！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的年日短少！ 願別人得他的職分！

en.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的儿女为孤儿， 他的妻子为寡妇！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的兒女為孤兒， 他的妻子為寡婦！

en.text: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭， 从他们荒凉之处出来求食！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的兒女漂流討飯， 從他們荒涼之處出來求食！

en.text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

zhSimplified.text: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！ 愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！

zhTraditional.text: 願強暴的債主牢籠他一切所有的！ 願外人搶他勞碌得來的！

en.text: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

zhSimplified.text: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！ 愿无人可怜他的孤儿！

zhTraditional.text: 願無人向他延綿施恩！ 願無人可憐他的孤兒！

en.text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的后人断绝， 名字被涂抹，不传于下代！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的後人斷絕， 名字被塗抹，不傳於下代！

en.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！ 愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！

zhTraditional.text: 願他祖宗的罪孽被耶和華記念！ 願他母親的罪過不被塗抹！

en.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

zhSimplified.text: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 使他的名号断绝于世！

zhTraditional.text: 願這些罪常在耶和華面前， 使他的名號斷絕於世！

en.text: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他不想施恩， 却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人， 要把他们治死。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他不想施恩， 卻逼迫困苦窮乏的和傷心的人， 要把他們治死。

en.text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

zhSimplified.text: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他； 他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！

zhTraditional.text: 他愛咒罵，咒罵就臨到他； 他不喜愛福樂，福樂就與他遠離！

en.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

zhSimplified.text: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上； 这咒骂就如水进他里面， 像油入他的骨头。

zhTraditional.text: 他拿咒罵當衣服穿上； 這咒罵就如水進他裏面， 像油入他的骨頭。

en.text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

zhSimplified.text: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服， 当他常束的腰带！

zhTraditional.text: 願這咒罵當他遮身的衣服， 當他常束的腰帶！

en.text: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人 从耶和华那里所受的报应。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是我對頭和用惡言議論我的人 從耶和華那裏所受的報應。

en.text: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

zhSimplified.text: 主—耶和华啊，求你为你的名恩待我； 因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！

zhTraditional.text: 主－耶和華啊，求你為你的名恩待我； 因你的慈愛美好，求你搭救我！

en.text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我困苦穷乏， 内心受伤。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我困苦窮乏， 內心受傷。

en.text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

zhSimplified.text: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去； 我如蝗虫被抖出来。

zhTraditional.text: 我如日影漸漸偏斜而去； 我如蝗蟲被抖出來。

en.text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

zhSimplified.text: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱； 我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。

zhTraditional.text: 我因禁食，膝骨軟弱； 我身上的肉也漸漸瘦了。

en.text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

zhSimplified.text: 我受他们的羞辱， 他们看见我便摇头。

zhTraditional.text: 我受他們的羞辱， 他們看見我便搖頭。

en.text: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，求你帮助我， 照你的慈爱拯救我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你幫助我， 照你的慈愛拯救我，

en.text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

zhSimplified.text: 使他们知道这是你的手， 是你—耶和华所行的事。

zhTraditional.text: 使他們知道這是你的手， 是你－耶和華所行的事。

en.text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福； 他们几时起来就必蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。

zhTraditional.text: 任憑他們咒罵，惟願你賜福； 他們幾時起來就必蒙羞， 你的僕人卻要歡喜。

en.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！ 愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！

zhTraditional.text: 願我的對頭披戴羞辱！ 願他們以自己的羞愧為外袍遮身！

en.text: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他；

zhTraditional.text: 我要用口極力稱謝耶和華； 我要在眾人中間讚美他；

en.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边， 要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他必站在窮乏人的右邊， 要救他脫離審判他靈魂的人。
